description: This script truncates a JSON-formatted NetLog file by removing the oldest events to reduce file size, based on a specified target size. It includes functions for parsing size strings, calculating file sizes, and performing the truncation.

methods.name: get_file_size
methods.description: Returns the filesize of a given file path in bytes.

methods.name: truncate_log_file
methods.description: Copies input log file to output, truncating old events to meet desired size.

methods.name: parse_filesize_str
methods.description: Parses a human-readable size string into a byte value.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments and initiates truncation.
